```{r load libraries, message=FALSE}
# container same as nf_xpatial: nf_xenium_analysis_0.0.5.sif
set.seed(1234)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
inputdir <- "./results/1_MapMyCells/"
outdir <- "./results/figures/"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Import main obj and markers
```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(file = paste0(inputdir,"compiled_area_norm_all_clusters_MMC.rds"))
```

```{r}
# markers linked to cell cluster calls
#### cluster numbers from clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2 ident ####
markers <- read.csv("./data/markers_refined.csv")

features_plot <- na.omit(unique(markers$marker))
```

# Figs

## DotPlot

```{r}
# clusters must be ordered
seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2 <- factor(seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2, 
                                                  levels = sort(unique(seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2)))

p1 <- DotPlot(seurat_obj, 
              features = features_plot,
              group.by = "clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2",
              assay = "AreaNorm",
              cols = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14, angle = 45, hjust=1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(paste0(outdir,"markers_dotplot.pdf"), p1, width = 9, height = 10, units = "in")
```

## Annotated UMAP

```{r}
# add cell calls to the seurat obj

# Create one row per peak_cluster
cluster_map <- markers %>%
  select(peak_cluster, cell_type) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(peak_cluster = as.character(peak_cluster))

celltype_vector <- setNames(cluster_map$cell_type, cluster_map$peak_cluster)

# Add annotation to Seurat metadata
seurat_obj$CellType <- unname(celltype_vector[as.character(seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2)])

# save annotated obj

saveRDS(seurat_obj,paste0(outdir,"seurat_area_norm_annotated.rds"))
```
